# Sample TypeScript Monorepo

This fixture is intentionally realistic enough for code-scout end-to-end tests to scan
package metadata, NestJS decorators, Next.js app router conventions, ADRs, and
OpenAPI contracts from one workspace.

The fixture is not meant to be installed or executed. Its source files are small
and dependency-free from the test runner's perspective so restricted-network
test runs can copy and scan the workspace offline.
